extracted.name: Southern Macaroni & Cheese
extracted.description: You're guaranteed to South your mouth with this one, folks!
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350°F. Cook pasta as directed, drain, and set aside in a casserole dish.
Melt butter in a pot. Stir in flour, salt, garlic powder, pepper, and paprika. Gradually add milk and heat to a simmer, stirring constantly. Add mustard.
Remove from heat and add cheese. Stir until smooth. Pour cheese sauce over macaroni and fold together until thoroughly combined.
In a pan, melt butter and add paprika. Mix in bread crumbs and brown. Sprinkle macaroni and cheese with bread crumb mixture and bake uncovered for 30 minutes.
